Make yourself comfortable

A good set.
A simple setup.

You bring the speakers, headphones, or television. The venue brings the music.

Watch on your computer or phone

  1. Choose a set and open its official live player. For a shared venue player, select the club named on the listing.
  2. Check the original event page for changes. Arrive a few minutes before the listed time.
  3. Press play if needed. If the video is silent, check the player’s mute control and your device volume.

A listing describes an announced broadcast. We cannot guarantee that a player will work in every country or on every device. Follow the provider’s access terms.

Put it on your television

Open the official stream on a laptop first. A compatible HDMI connection is one option. If your television supports casting, use your browser or device’s Cast feature and follow its prompts. Player support varies; keep the original device handy.

For Chrome, use Google’s official casting instructions. A provider’s own television app may also be available.

Save the time

“Add to calendar” downloads one set. “Download these sets” saves your current filtered selection. The .ics file imports into common calendar apps. Times are stored in UTC so your calendar can display them locally.

Downloads are snapshots, not subscriptions. Changes and cancellations will not automatically update your calendar. Unknown end times use a disclosed 90-minute estimate. Stable event IDs help identify repeats, but duplicate-import behavior depends on your calendar app.

Can I watch later?

Maybe. Live access and archive access are different. Smalls and Mezzrow provide free live viewing; their archive has a separate supporting-member model. Jazz Watch does not promise a replay.
